newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes unchanged after fluctuating.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes unchanged after fluctuating.

text.p: The won closed unchanged against the dollar after fluctuating in line with the dollar/yen movements in world markets, dealers said on Wedensday.
The won finished at Tuesday's close of 894.80 after opening at 893.00.

It dropped to a day low of 896.20 after the dollar gained strength against the yen to promot some traders to go long on the dollars in the won/dollar market. It recouped its losses to mirror the Japanese unit's performance.
"The won fluctuated in line with rises and falls in the dollar/yen rate," said a foreign bank dealer.

Dealers said the dollar's rise was limited after a finance ministry official forecast the won/dollar rate would remain stable around the 890 level. The official ruled out the possibility that the exchange rate would climb over the 900 level, unless the yen/dollar rate reached the 127 mark.
A local bank dealer said he expected the dollar to move in a 894.50-896.00 range on Thursday, while another foreign bank dealer put it at between 894.50 and 896.00.
Thursday's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 895.20 against 894.00 today. Trading volume was estimated at a moderate $1.2 billion, dealers said. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727 5647
